item.title: 16 firefighters, 4 medics, 3 fire trucks, ambulance respond to man unable to take off bus seatbelt
item.description: Hong Kong bus operator Citybus has filed a police report after it found a piece of aluminium foil stuffed inside a seatbelt buckle, which reportedly left a passenger trapped for over 45 minutes. Sixteen firefighters, four medics, three fire trucks, an ambulance and ambulance motorcycle were deployed to the scene. The passenger was freed and […]

item.title: Panama’s top court annuls Hong Kong-based CK Hutchison’s canal port concession
item.description: Panama’s Supreme Court annulled on Thursday the concession allowing Hong Kong-based CK Hutchison to operate ports at the Panama Canal, a year after US President Donald Trump threatened to seize the crucial passageway claiming China controlled it.
